statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 is an advisory against golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, which is unmaintained and unsafe by design. provider-k3s requires golang.org/x/crypto v0.56.0 directly, but only for SSH node provisioning: the x/crypto packages that reach this provider's build are golang.org/x/crypto/ssh and the primitives it pulls with it (blowfish, chacha20, curve25519, cryptobyte, internal/poly1305, ssh/internal/bcrypt_pbkdf). The openpgp package is not among them. Measured on provider-k3s at commit 90b16ca: `go list -deps ./...` returns zero packages matching openpgp, so the vulnerable code is not compiled into the provider binary at all -- it is not merely uncalled, it is not linked. govulncheck agrees at symbol level and reports 'Your code may be affected by 0 vulnerabilities', flagging GO-2026-5932 only as a module-level finding against a module this provider requires for an unrelated package. grype with --only-fixed returns 0 matches, consistent with the advisory carrying no fixed version. Risk accepted by Tobias Kaesser on 2026-09-09. No upstream fix exists (Fixed in: N/A) and none is expected -- the advisory's remedy is to stop using the package, which this provider already does not use. This exception is void the moment golang.org/x/crypto publishes a fixed version for this advisory, or the moment any openpgp package enters this provider's build graph.
